answer: Each identity is admitted only after a Wesolowski VDF proves completion of a prescribed chain of modular squarings, with a beacon fixing the challenge and deadline. Squarings within one chain are sequential, so GPUs cannot shorten that identity’s elapsed time; clones can run in parallel only by using more hardware. Sybil creation therefore carries a per-identity time-and-resource cost, not a free software shortcut, whether a node is labeled violet or haven.
